# Overview

The CDS length panel from `19_firefly_vs_nanoluc_target_features.Rmd`, repeated
for every cell line and condition with an eIF3d TE contrast and stacked on one
shared x axis, so the promoted-set shift can be compared across datasets in one
figure. No reporter constructs are drawn.

**The four panels.**

| cell line | condition | contrast file |
|---|---|---|
| MDA-MB-231 | hypoxia 1hr | `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv` |
| MDA-MB-231 | normoxia 1+4hr, time-regressed | `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv` |
| MCF7-SIX1 | hypoxia 1hr | `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv` |
| MCF7-SIX1 | normoxia 1hr | `output/translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_normoxia_1hr.csv` |

MDA-MB-231 normoxia uses the time-regressed 1+4hr contrast rather than plain 1hr
(the project convention). MCF7-SIX1 has only a 1hr timepoint.

**Terms used below.**

* *promoted set* - genes with `te_lfc > 0.5` and `te_padj < 0.05` in that
  panel's si3d contrast. Every file here is promotes-positive: the MDA-MB-231
  files carry the `sictrl_vs_si3d` coefficient (despite the filename), and the
  MCF7-SIX1 files were negated from log2(si3d / sictrl) by
  `10m_mcf7six1_outcome_prep.Rmd`. Both are asserted below.
* *rest of the transcriptome* - every other transcript in that cell line's
  expressed set. Disjoint from the promoted set, so the two curves are the two
  groups the Wilcoxon test compares. (Notebook 19 drew all expressed mRNAs,
  promoted included, as its grey curve; this one draws the rest.)
* *expressed set* - one transcript per gene, **that cell line's own dominant
  isoform**: `feature_matrix_external_stability.rds` for MDA-MB-231 (the matrix
  notebook 19 uses) and `feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds` for MCF7-SIX1. 35% of
  shared genes pick a different transcript in the two lines, so borrowing one
  cell line's isoform for the other would put one molecule's length next to
  another's measurement. Restricted to transcripts with a complete CDS in GENCODE
  v49 (in frame, terminal stop present).
* *CDS length* - nt, stop codon excluded, from `build_cds_metrics()`, the same
  definition notebook 19 plots.

**One difference from notebook 19.** Notebook 19 added back promoted genes that
are missing from the MDA-MB-231 matrix by picking their top transcript from the
hypoxia siCTRL salmon quant. That augmentation exists for one condition of one
cell line only, so it is not repeated here; every panel uses its matrix alone and
the number of promoted genes without a transcript is reported per panel. The
MDA-MB-231 hypoxia panel's promoted n is therefore slightly smaller than notebook
19's.

# 1. Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)

source(here("code", "cds_reporter_design", "reporter_helpers.R"))

lfc_cutoff  <- 0.5
padj_cutoff <- 0.05

stopifnot("xmax_cds_nt must be positive" = params$xmax_cds_nt > 0)
```

# 2. Contrasts and promoted sets

```{r registry}
registry <- tribble(
  ~cell_line,   ~condition,                         ~file,
  "MDA-MB-231", "normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)",  "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1and4hr.csv",
  "MDA-MB-231", "hypoxia 1hr",                      "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv",
  "MCF7-SIX1",  "normoxia 1hr",                     "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_normoxia_1hr.csv",
  "MCF7-SIX1",  "hypoxia 1hr",                      "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv"
) %>%
  # Row order sets the grid: normoxia left, hypoxia right; MDA-MB-231 on top,
  # MCF7-SIX1 below (facet_wrap fills row by row).
  mutate(panel = paste0(cell_line, ", ", condition),
         path  = here("output", file))

stopifnot("a contrast file is missing" = all(file.exists(registry$path)))

contrasts <- setNames(
  map(registry$path, ~ read_csv(.x, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
        mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))),
  registry$panel)
```

**Direction checks.** MDA-MB-231: EIF3D's own `rna_lfc` must be strongly
positive, because the siRNA depletes its target. MCF7-SIX1 has no `rna_lfc`, so
that check would silently skip; instead assert that the file is the exact
negation of the DESeq2 output it was written from, and that it correlates
**positively** with the matched MDA-MB-231 contrast - the one ruler on
independent data (`10m_` shows the un-negated orientation fails it in every
contrast).

```{r direction_checks}
for (p in registry$panel[registry$cell_line == "MDA-MB-231"]) {
  e <- contrasts[[p]] %>% filter(symbol == "EIF3D") %>% pull(rna_lfc)
  stopifnot("EIF3D rna_lfc is not strongly positive: contrast direction may be flipped" =
              length(e) == 1 && e > 2)
  cat(sprintf("%-45s EIF3D rna_lfc = %+.2f\n", p, e))
}

matched_231 <- c("MCF7-SIX1, hypoxia 1hr"  = "MDA-MB-231, hypoxia 1hr",
                 "MCF7-SIX1, normoxia 1hr" = "MDA-MB-231, normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)")
for (p in names(matched_231)) {
  d <- contrasts[[p]]
  stopifnot(
    "MCF7-SIX1 file is not the negation of its DESeq2 log2FoldChange" =
      isTRUE(all.equal(d$te_lfc, -d$source_log2FoldChange)))
  j <- inner_join(d %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, mcf = te_lfc),
                  contrasts[[matched_231[[p]]]] %>%
                    dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, mda = te_lfc),
                  by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    filter(is.finite(mcf), is.finite(mda))
  rho <- cor(j$mcf, j$mda, method = "spearman")
  stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 TE does not correlate positively with the matched MDA-MB-231 contrast" =
              rho > 0.05)
  cat(sprintf("%-45s Spearman vs %s = %+.3f (n = %s)\n",
              p, matched_231[[p]], rho, fmt_n(nrow(j))))
}
```

```{r promoted_sets}
promoted_genes <- map(contrasts, ~ .x %>%
  filter(te_lfc > lfc_cutoff, !is.na(te_padj), te_padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
  distinct(gene_id_clean) %>% pull(gene_id_clean))

# Set sizes are the ones the project's gene set files and notebooks already
# report (1,604 in notebook 19; 853 / 233 in 42_ and 10m_). 426 is the
# normoxia 1+4hr count at this cut.
expected_n <- c("MDA-MB-231, normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)" = 426,
                "MDA-MB-231, hypoxia 1hr"                     = 1604,
                "MCF7-SIX1, normoxia 1hr"                     = 233,
                "MCF7-SIX1, hypoxia 1hr"                      = 853)
stopifnot("a promoted set changed size" =
            all(lengths(promoted_genes)[names(expected_n)] == expected_n))

# Cross-check against the gene set CSVs where they exist, so this rebuild cannot
# drift from the sets the models use.
gs_files <- c("MDA-MB-231, hypoxia 1hr" = "hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv",
              "MCF7-SIX1, hypoxia 1hr"  = "mcf7six1_hypoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv",
              "MCF7-SIX1, normoxia 1hr" = "mcf7six1_normoxia_3d_promotes_TE_1hr_lfc0.5.csv")
for (p in names(gs_files)) {
  gs <- read_csv(here("output", "genesets", gs_files[[p]]), show_col_types = FALSE)
  stopifnot("promoted set does not reproduce its gene set CSV" =
              setequal(sub("\\..*", "", gs$ensembl_gene), promoted_genes[[p]]))
}
print(tibble(panel = names(promoted_genes), promoted_genes = lengths(promoted_genes)))
```

# 3. Transcripts and CDS length

```{r cds_metrics}
TXDB <- here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite")
cds_metrics <- build_cds_metrics(TXDB) %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, cds_length)

stopifnot(
  "CDS lengths must be divisible by 3" = all(cds_metrics$cds_length %% 3 == 0),
  "CDS lengths must be positive"       = all(cds_metrics$cds_length > 0)
)
```

```{r expressed_sets}
matrices <- list(
  "MDA-MB-231" = here("output", "predictive_modeling",
                      "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"),
  "MCF7-SIX1"  = here("output", "translational_control_overview",
                      "feature_matrix_tco_mcf7six1.rds"))

expressed <- imap(matrices, function(path, cl) {
  fm <- readRDS(path) %>%
    dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol) %>%
    distinct()
  stopifnot("matrix is not one transcript per gene" =
              !any(duplicated(fm$gene_id_clean)))
  out <- fm %>% inner_join(cds_metrics, by = "transcript_id_clean")
  cat(sprintf("%-11s %s of %s matrix transcripts carry a complete GENCODE v49 CDS\n",
              cl, fmt_n(nrow(out)), fmt_n(nrow(fm))))
  out
})

# Biological spot-check: ribosomal protein mRNAs are short. If the join had
# attached the wrong length this would not hold.
#
# ACTB's full CDS is 1,125 nt (375 aa, stop excluded); asserted for MDA-MB-231
# only. The MCF7-SIX1 matrix gives ACTB the 375 nt fragment ENST00000425660:
# its quant is GENCODE v26, and transcripts retired since v26 are invisible to
# the v49 dominant-isoform pick (~252 genes, ACTB the worst). That is a known,
# unfixed property of the MCF7-SIX1 matrix, so it is reported, not asserted.
e231 <- expressed[["MDA-MB-231"]]
stopifnot("MDA-MB-231 ACTB CDS length is not 1,125 nt (stop excluded)" =
            e231$cds_length[e231$symbol == "ACTB"] == 1125)
cat(sprintf("ACTB CDS length: MDA-MB-231 %s nt, MCF7-SIX1 %s nt (v26 isoform issue)\n",
            fmt_n(e231$cds_length[e231$symbol == "ACTB"]),
            fmt_n(expressed[["MCF7-SIX1"]]$cds_length[expressed[["MCF7-SIX1"]]$symbol == "ACTB"])))

for (cl in names(expressed)) {
  e  <- expressed[[cl]]
  rp <- e %>% filter(str_detect(symbol, "^RP[SL]\\d"))
  stopifnot(
    "too few ribosomal protein genes for the spot-check" = nrow(rp) >= 50,
    "ribosomal protein CDSs are not shorter than the median: join suspect" =
      median(rp$cds_length) < median(e$cds_length),
    "median CDS length outside the expected 900-2,000 nt range" =
      between(median(e$cds_length), 900, 2000)
  )
}
```

```{r assemble}
plot_df <- pmap_dfr(registry, function(cell_line, condition, panel, ...) {
  e   <- expressed[[cell_line]]
  pro <- promoted_genes[[panel]]
  n_missing <- sum(!pro %in% e$gene_id_clean)
  cat(sprintf("%-45s %s of %s promoted genes have no complete-CDS transcript in the %s matrix\n",
              panel, fmt_n(n_missing), fmt_n(length(pro)), cell_line))
  e %>% mutate(panel = panel, cell_line = cell_line, condition = condition,
               group = if_else(gene_id_clean %in% pro,
                               "eIF3d promotes", "Rest of the transcriptome"))
}) %>%
  mutate(panel = factor(panel, levels = registry$panel),
         group = factor(group, levels = c("Rest of the transcriptome",
                                          "eIF3d promotes")))
```

```{r panel_stats}
stats <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pro    = sum(group == "eIF3d promotes"),
    n_rest   = sum(group == "Rest of the transcriptome"),
    med_pro  = median(cds_length[group == "eIF3d promotes"]),
    med_rest = median(cds_length[group == "Rest of the transcriptome"]),
    p        = wilcox.test(cds_length[group == "eIF3d promotes"],
                           cds_length[group == "Rest of the transcriptome"])$p.value,
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(strip = sprintf(
    "%s\npromoted n = %s, median %s nt\nrest n = %s, median %s nt\nWilcoxon p = %s",
    panel, fmt_n(n_pro), fmt_n(round(med_pro)), fmt_n(n_rest),
    fmt_n(round(med_rest)), format.pval(p, digits = 2)))

print(as.data.frame(stats %>% dplyr::select(-strip)))

plot_df <- plot_df %>%
  left_join(stats %>% dplyr::select(panel, strip), by = "panel") %>%
  mutate(strip = factor(strip, levels = stats$strip[match(registry$panel, stats$panel)]))

n_off <- sum(plot_df$cds_length > params$xmax_cds_nt)
cat(sprintf("x axis clipped at %s nt; %s of %s plotted transcripts (%.1f%%) beyond it\n",
            fmt_n(params$xmax_cds_nt), fmt_n(n_off), fmt_n(nrow(plot_df)),
            100 * n_off / nrow(plot_df)))
```

# 4. Grid panel

```{r stacked_cds_length, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
group_cols <- c("Rest of the transcriptome" = "grey70",
                "eIF3d promotes"            = "#E69F00")

p_stack <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cds_length, color = group)) +
  geom_density(fill = NA, linewidth = 1, trim = TRUE, key_glyph = "path") +
  facet_wrap(~ strip, ncol = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = group_cols, breaks = names(group_cols), name = NULL) +
  # coord_cartesian zooms without dropping rows, so each density is still
  # estimated from every transcript; only the visible range is clipped.
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, params$xmax_cds_nt), ylim = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(x = "CDS length (nt)", y = "Density",
       title = "CDS length of eIF3d-promoted mRNAs by cell line and condition") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11),
        axis.text        = element_text(colour = "black"),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.text      = element_text(size = 11))

print(p_stack)
ggsave(here("plots", "20_cds_length_density_by_cell_line_condition.pdf"),
       p_stack, width = 12, height = 9)
```

# 5. Shared targets: MDA-MB-231 and MCF7-SIX1

**Shared target** - a gene in the eIF3d-promoted set of *both* cell lines in the
same condition (normoxia: MDA-MB-231 1+4hr time-regressed with MCF7-SIX1 1hr;
hypoxia: both 1hr). Matched at gene level, since the two cell lines can use
different transcripts of the same gene.

**Is the overlap more than chance?** A gene can only be shared if both
experiments tested it, so the background is every gene with a non-NA `te_padj`
in **both** contrasts, and both promoted sets are restricted to it before the
Fisher test. Normoxia first, then hypoxia.

```{r overlap}
conditions <- tribble(
  ~condition, ~panel_231,                                     ~panel_mcf7,
  "normoxia", "MDA-MB-231, normoxia 1+4hr (time-regressed)",  "MCF7-SIX1, normoxia 1hr",
  "hypoxia",  "MDA-MB-231, hypoxia 1hr",                      "MCF7-SIX1, hypoxia 1hr"
)
stopifnot("overlap panels must exist in the registry" =
            all(c(conditions$panel_231, conditions$panel_mcf7) %in% registry$panel))

tested <- function(p) contrasts[[p]] %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>% distinct(gene_id_clean) %>% pull(gene_id_clean)

overlap <- pmap(conditions, function(condition, panel_231, panel_mcf7) {
  universe <- intersect(tested(panel_231), tested(panel_mcf7))
  a <- intersect(promoted_genes[[panel_231]],  universe)
  b <- intersect(promoted_genes[[panel_mcf7]], universe)
  shared <- intersect(a, b)
  stopifnot("a promoted gene is missing from its own tested set" =
              all(promoted_genes[[panel_231]]  %in% tested(panel_231)) &&
              all(promoted_genes[[panel_mcf7]] %in% tested(panel_mcf7)))
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(length(shared),
                             length(a) - length(shared),
                             length(b) - length(shared),
                             length(universe) - length(union(a, b))),
                           nrow = 2), alternative = "greater")
  # Counts computed outside tibble(): inside it, a column named `shared` would
  # shadow the gene vector for every later column.
  n_sh <- length(shared); n_a <- length(a); n_b <- length(b)
  list(condition = condition, shared = shared,
       summary = tibble(
         condition,
         tested_in_both  = length(universe),
         promoted_231    = n_a,
         promoted_mcf7   = n_b,
         shared          = n_sh,
         expected        = round(n_a * n_b / length(universe), 1),
         pct_of_231      = round(100 * n_sh / n_a, 1),
         pct_of_mcf7     = round(100 * n_sh / n_b, 1),
         odds_ratio      = round(unname(ft$estimate), 2),
         fisher_p        = format.pval(ft$p.value, digits = 2)))
})
names(overlap) <- conditions$condition

knitr::kable(map_dfr(overlap, "summary"))
```

```{r overlap_genes}
# The shared genes, with each cell line's own transcript and CDS length, so a
# gene whose two cell lines use different isoforms is visible rather than hidden.
shared_tbl <- imap_dfr(overlap, function(o, cond) {
  tibble(condition = cond, gene_id_clean = o$shared) %>%
    left_join(expressed[["MDA-MB-231"]] %>%
                dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol,
                              tx_231 = transcript_id_clean, cds_231 = cds_length),
              by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    left_join(expressed[["MCF7-SIX1"]] %>%
                dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol_mcf7 = symbol,
                              tx_mcf7 = transcript_id_clean, cds_mcf7 = cds_length),
              by = "gene_id_clean") %>%
    mutate(symbol = coalesce(symbol, symbol_mcf7),
           same_transcript = tx_231 == tx_mcf7) %>%
    dplyr::select(-symbol_mcf7)
}) %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = conditions$condition)) %>%
  arrange(condition, cds_231)

shared_tbl %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(shared = n(),
            with_231_transcript  = sum(!is.na(tx_231)),
            with_mcf7_transcript = sum(!is.na(tx_mcf7)),
            same_transcript      = sum(same_transcript, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable()

write_csv(shared_tbl,
          here("output", "20_si3d_promoted_shared_231_mcf7six1_by_condition.csv"))
knitr::kable(shared_tbl %>% dplyr::select(condition, symbol, cds_231, cds_mcf7,
                                          same_transcript))
```

**Shared targets on each panel.** The same grid as section 4, with a third curve
for the shared targets in that condition, drawn on each cell line's own
transcript, plus one rug tick per shared gene, because a density over a few
dozen genes is shaped as much by the bandwidth as by the data. The shared genes
are a subset of the promoted set, so the orange curve still includes them.

```{r shared_stats}
shared_by_panel <- set_names(
  map(registry$panel, function(p) {
    cond <- if (str_detect(p, "normoxia")) "normoxia" else "hypoxia"
    overlap[[cond]]$shared
  }),
  registry$panel)

plot_shared <- plot_df %>%
  dplyr::select(-strip) %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% unlist(shared_by_panel)) %>%
  filter(map2_lgl(gene_id_clean, as.character(panel),
                  ~ .x %in% shared_by_panel[[.y]])) %>%
  mutate(group = "Shared target (both cell lines)")

stopifnot("every shared gene with a transcript must already be in the promoted group" =
            all(paste(plot_shared$panel, plot_shared$gene_id_clean) %in%
                  with(plot_df %>% filter(group == "eIF3d promotes"),
                       paste(panel, gene_id_clean))))

stats_shared <- plot_df %>%
  group_by(panel) %>%
  summarise(n_pro    = sum(group == "eIF3d promotes"),
            med_pro  = median(cds_length[group == "eIF3d promotes"]),
            n_rest   = sum(group == "Rest of the transcriptome"),
            med_rest = median(cds_length[group == "Rest of the transcriptome"]),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(plot_shared %>% group_by(panel) %>%
              summarise(n_shared   = n(),
                        med_shared = median(cds_length), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "panel") %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(p_shared = wilcox.test(
    plot_shared$cds_length[plot_shared$panel == panel],
    plot_df$cds_length[plot_df$panel == panel &
                         plot_df$group == "Rest of the transcriptome"])$p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(strip = sprintf(
    "%s\nshared n = %s, median %s nt (vs rest p = %s)\npromoted n = %s, median %s nt\nrest n = %s, median %s nt",
    panel, fmt_n(n_shared), fmt_n(round(med_shared)), format.pval(p_shared, digits = 2),
    fmt_n(n_pro), fmt_n(round(med_pro)), fmt_n(n_rest), fmt_n(round(med_rest))))

print(as.data.frame(stats_shared %>% dplyr::select(-strip)))

strip_levels <- stats_shared$strip[match(registry$panel, stats_shared$panel)]
add_strip <- function(d) d %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of("strip")) %>%
  left_join(stats_shared %>% dplyr::select(panel, strip), by = "panel") %>%
  mutate(strip = factor(strip, levels = strip_levels))

plot_df_sh     <- add_strip(plot_df)
plot_shared_sh <- add_strip(plot_shared)
```

```{r shared_cds_length, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}

                 "Shared target (both cell lines)" = "#CC79A7")

p_shared <- ggplot(mapping = aes(x = cds_length, color = group)) +

               key_glyph = "path") +

  labs(x = "CDS length (nt)", y = "Density",

  theme(strip.background = element_blank(),

print(p_shared)
ggsave(here("plots", "20_cds_length_density_shared_targets_231_mcf7six1.pdf"),
```
